findings.text: The 1,939 theorems with one user in the exporter output are not an upper bound on the proposed result, because two generated callers can fold into one written caller. Fix: describe the figures as counts in the original exporter graph.

D1 includes every Lean source file in the working tree, but the cited build excludes separate test and experiment trees, and the specification explicitly permits an unselected test tree. Fix: define the snapshot by an explicit selection of built modules and require matching artifacts for every selected source.

The key can reuse obsolete relationships after a successful rebuild because changing the SQL read by `sql_module` can change the declarations it generates while every listed key input stays identical. Fix: include the identities of the matching `.olean` and `.ilean` artifacts in the key, including any split `.olean` parts the exporter reads.

The recommended database option assumes the ADR 0028 credentials can create and populate `lean_code`, but the devops handoff grants access specifically to `belay_observability`. Fix: make grants for `lean_code` an explicit prerequisite of option (a).

The record says collecting proof info trees requires disabling `Elab.async`, but Lean 4.34.1’s own frontend collects them from completed snapshots with `snaps.getAll`. Fix: say that a collector must await the proof snapshots if it keeps asynchronous elaboration enabled.

No specified query or completion check reads `processed_at`, contrary to D5’s requirement that each column serve incremental extraction or the single-use query. Fix: remove `processed_at` and use the presence of the `file_key` row as the completion marker.

Stripping private prefixes loses declaration identity, so two private callers with the same display name can make `uniqExact(r.user_name)` report one user even when the target is public. Fix: retain exact kernel names for both endpoints and strip private prefixes only for display.

Lean 4.34.1 records a nonempty `_example` parent for references in anonymous examples, so copying the parent name bypasses the proposed empty-user exclusion and can count several examples as one caller. Fix: map references in anonymous examples to the empty-user marker by checking their source range against authored declarations.

The `.ilean` `decls` map omits the written mutual inductive `Belay.Sqlite.Model.Resolved.Arguments`, although the compiled environment contains its full source range. Fix: enumerate module constants from the environment and match their declaration ranges against authored source declarators, as the public documentation inventory does.

The existing exporter supplies kernel kinds only, so it reports an ordinary instance as `definition` and a structure or class as `inductive`, contrary to the stated coverage of `entities.kind`. Fix: list structure, class and instance classification among the required exporter additions.

Comparing a product’s timestamp with its own source accepts an unchanged importer’s stale product after an import changes and rejects valid products after a timestamp-only `touch`. Fix: require a successful build of the selected modules against the snapshot inputs and extract from that build.

Rule 2 omits the ADR’s no-source-range condition, so it folds a written declaration such as `Foo._helper` whenever `Foo` is also a constant. Fix: apply the name heuristic only after ruling out an authored declaration at that range.

The range of a derived instance need not be inside the type’s range, as `Tree.lean` derives `Inhabited` for `ParseNode` imported from another module. Fix: distinguish an inline `deriving` clause from a standalone `deriving instance` command and attribute the latter’s generated constants to the command in its own file.

The query reads `snapshot_files` without checking `snapshots`, so a command interrupted between steps 5 and 6 can return results for a snapshot the write protocol marks incomplete. Fix: require a matching completion row in `snapshots` when selecting the file keys.

The query omits single-use definitions and theorems used in their caller’s type, although the ADR asks to find each declaration with exactly one other declaration as a user. Fix: count distinct callers across all entity and reference kinds, then apply theorem-only or body-only filters as optional refinements.
